title: FHFA House Price Index — Monthly Index (January 2027 data), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this event's own lane, independently of the sweep that proposed the id. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) — its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table reads "Tuesday, March 30 | Monthly Index | January 2027", the third of twelve dated 2027 rows (Jan 26 -> Dec 28, every one a last Tuesday). (2) The published 2026Q2 report (fhfa.gov/document/d/hpi/fhfa-house-price-index-report-2026q2, HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes; 517 stream objects located, 511 inflated in-session with node zlib), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row above the statement "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" — a published document, not a second reading of the same web table. THE EDITION TYPE IS QUOTED, NOT INFERRED: the same table marks exactly four 2027 rows "Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables)" — February 23, May 25, August 31, November 30 — and March is not among them. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on the precedent fhfa-hpi-2027-01-26, -2027-09-28, -2027-10-26, -2027-11-30 and -2027-12-28 set: the no-self-confirm limit binds the DISCOVERING sweep (fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30), not this event's own independent second look. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 initial-research sweep (2026-09-08) as one of five untracked 2027 editions; researched the same day and the proposal file is now shadowed by this canonical one. INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-08 (docs/research/events/fhfa-hpi-2027-03-30.md) BROKE THE CHAIN'S SECOND LOAD-BEARING BEAM. The fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 lane built a 09:00-09:30 ET pre-market window and tabulated that hour as carrying "the FHFA release, and nothing else scheduled"; seven ledgers have leaned on it. IT IS NOT FHFA-ONLY. S&P Dow Jones Indices' own press release for the June-2026 edition (press.spglobal.com, HTTP 200, 90,693 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-08) states verbatim: "The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Indices are published on the last Tuesday of each month at 9:00 am ET" — the SAME rule and the SAME minute FHFA adopted post-2020. Nine dated Case-Shiller releases were harvested from the publisher's own archive this session and ALL NINE fell on an FHFA release date (2025-08-26, 2025-09-30, 2026-01-27, 2026-02-24, 2026-04-28, 2026-05-26, 2026-06-30, 2026-07-28, 2026-08-25). So the 10:00 Conference Board confound the chain apologised for has a 9:00 twin that is same-topic and better-followed, and the 12-28 lane's "clean daily design" for December is clean about the Conference Board only. THE ONE VERIFIED FHFA-ONLY 9:00 MORNING IN THE MODERN SAMPLE IS A MARCH RELEASE: no Case-Shiller release exists in March 2026 (2026-02-24 covers December 2025, 2026-04-28 covers January 2026, a nine-week gap), while FHFA published 2026-03-31 — n=1, reported and not used. SECOND METHOD UPGRADE, AND IT RETIRES A REGIME LABEL: the 12-28 lane's year-end axis is a HOLIDAY axis. Counting market closures in the 9 calendar days forward of each session sorts VIX9D/VIX monotonically — 0.9510 (n=3,110, no closure) / 0.8993 (n=809, one) / 0.8746 (n=22, two), p=0.0000 — and 65 of the 75 year-end sessions carry at least one. Controlled on that count, quarter-end survives as a SEPARATE and SIGN-INVERTED axis: the last five sessions of Q1/Q2/Q3 STEEPEN the front (0.9587 vs 0.9413, p=0.0156; 0.9697 vs 0.9501, p=0.0348 restricted to holiday-free windows) where year-end COMPRESSES it (0.9006, p=0.0017), the two differing at p=0.0000. Applying December's control to a March print would push the reading the wrong way. THIS DATE'S PLACEMENT IS THEREFORE DETERMINED AND CLEAN: 2027-03-30 is the fourth of Q1 2027's five final sessions and the second from the end, and its forward 9-day window (03-31 -> 04-08) holds NO closure, because Good Friday 2027 falls 03-26, four days BEHIND it. THE LAST-TUESDAY POLICY RELOCATED THIS PRINT: FHFA releases in quarter-ending months sat inside the quarter's final five sessions 16 of 52 times pre-policy and 22 of 22 since (March alone: 4 of 13 -> 6 of 6). FED AXIS CLEAN: the last Tuesday of March is in an FOMC blackout 0 of 7 and an FOMC day 0 of 7 across 2021-2027, from all 56 posted meeting pairs re-parsed this session; 2027's March meeting is 03-16/17, blackout 03-06 -> 03-18, clearing this print by 12 days. TAPE: 16 March releases separate from nothing on four daily metrics against four controls, smallest p 0.1392. CONTENT: January is the eighth reference month tested and stays refuted (32/35 all-time, 14/15 since 2012, p=0.5197 / p=0.7844). symbols: [] and 0 hits for any housing or macro keying in trade-playbooks.md or multi-symbol-sweep.md (re-grepped 2026-09-08); nothing here licenses an entry.
